purpose: Review state for the #35 contact sheet artifacts uploaded by CI (review-artifacts).

visual_review.note: State machine (round 5, logic unit-tested in review-state.test.ts): status is one of pending/reviewed/rejected/skipped. A reviewer flips status to "reviewed" in a committed change AND fills reviewer, date, head (the 40-hex sha of the run whose six shots were reviewed) and shots_sha256 (sha256 of the six shots, copied from the generated manifest.json of that run). The BINDING is the shot hashes: the e2e contact test re-hashes the shots it just took and keeps the signature only while every hash matches, auto-reverting to pending with a reason when any drifts; head is provenance, not binding, because committing the signature necessarily creates a new head and a head-equality binding could never be satisfied (round-4 review P1). "rejected" and "skipped" are visible but never satisfy the review: the contact test fails on them after uploading the evidence.
